vocabulary.word: burn the candle at both ends
vocabulary.meaning_en: work very hard, from early morning until late at night
vocabulary.meaning_ar: يُرهق نفسه بالعمل من الصباح حتى الليل
vocabulary.example: You're burning the candle at both ends this week.

vocabulary.meaning_en: work more hours than your normal working hours
vocabulary.example: I did five hours of overtime last week.

vocabulary.meaning_en: extra hours of work after normal hours
spend all the time needed to do something well
vocabulary.meaning_ar: يكرّس الوقت اللازم / يعمل ساعات طويلة
vocabulary.example: She's putting in the hours to finish the project.

vocabulary.meaning_en: become very tired and lose energy from working too hard
vocabulary.example: If you don't rest, you'll burn out.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the normal hours when people work in an office
vocabulary.example: Most people finish their work within office hours.

vocabulary.meaning_en: stay at work after the normal time
vocabulary.meaning_ar: يتأخّر في العمل / يعمل حتى وقت متأخر
vocabulary.example: I had to work late yesterday.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a talk to show information or a product

vocabulary.example: You need to be realistic about the time.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the strength to work and be active

vocabulary.note_ar: لا تأتي قبل الاسم: نقول she is asleep
vocabulary.example: She fell asleep at her desk.

vocabulary.meaning_en: stop someone while they are speaking or working
enter a building and steal things
vocabulary.example: Do you think we've been burgled?
If you're too tired, you'll be of no use to anyone.

vocabulary.word: as useful as a chocolate teapot
vocabulary.example: This old printer is as useful as a chocolate teapot.

vocabulary.meaning_en: understand what someone is trying to tell you
vocabulary.example: She finally got the message and went home.

fine_lines.title: overtime vs office hours
fine_lines.explanation_ar: office hours هي ساعات الدوام العادية، وovertime هي الساعات الإضافية بعدها.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Office hours are your normal working hours. Overtime is extra time after them.

examples.sentence: Please call us during office hours.

fine_lines.title: tired vs exhausted vs burnt out
fine_lines.explanation_ar: tired متعب عادي، exhausted منهك جدًا، burnt out منهك تمامًا لفترة طويلة بسبب العمل الزائد.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Tired = you need some rest. Exhausted = extremely tired. Burnt out = tired for a long time from too much work.

examples.sentence: I'm tired; I'll go to bed early.
After the long trip I was exhausted.
After months of overtime, he felt burnt out.

expressions.phrase: You're burning the candle at both ends.
expressions.meaning_ar: أنت تُرهق نفسك بالعمل ليلًا ونهارًا.
expressions.meaning_en: You work early and late all the time.
expressions.example: You're burning the candle at both ends. Please take a break.

expressions.meaning_en: You work longer than office hours.
expressions.example: You're doing a lot of overtime this month.

expressions.meaning_en: You are spending the time needed to succeed.
expressions.example: I'm putting in the hours to make sure the report is perfect.

expressions.phrase: If you're not careful, you'll burn out.
expressions.meaning_en: A warning about working too hard.
expressions.example: Slow down. If you're not careful, you'll burn out.

expressions.meaning_en: Ask someone not to stop you (this is a little rude).
expressions.example: Don't interrupt! I'm busy. We can talk later.

expressions.meaning_en: Say you are too tired to think.
expressions.example: I've been working for ten hours. I can't think clearly anymore.

grammar.title: Present perfect continuous for long activities
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم have/has been + فعل بـ -ing للحديث عن نشاط بدأ في الماضي وما زال مستمرًا حتى الآن، خاصة لإبراز طول المدة: You've been burning the candle at both ends lately.
grammar.explanation_en: Use have/has been + -ing for an activity that started in the past and continues now, often to show it is long.
examples: You've been working too hard lately.
She has been doing overtime all week.
I've been preparing this presentation for days.

grammar.title: Present continuous for what is happening around now
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم am/is/are + فعل بـ -ing لما يحدث الآن أو هذه الفترة: You're doing overtime. I'm putting in the hours.
grammar.explanation_en: Use am/is/are + -ing for things happening now or these days.
examples: I'm putting in the hours this month.

choices: working very hard, early and late
questions.explanation_ar: تعني العمل بجهد كبير من الصباح حتى الليل.
questions.explanation_en: It means working very hard, early and late.
